blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by drafting multiple tokens per step, yet feature-based drafters rely on target hidden features whose contextual emphasis may not align with the needs of subsequent draft positions. Hybrid linear attention (HLA) models maintain compact recurrent states that accumulate historical associations, offering an efficient source of complementary context for speculative drafting. We introduce ReaDy, the first speculative decoding method, to the best of our knowledge, to leverage HLA recurrent states for position-specific context retrieval during drafting. ReaDy equips each draft position with a learned query to retrieve supplementary context directly from the target's committed recurrent states. A lightweight state reader integrates this context into draft representations through residual updates, while low-rank state reads and fused operators keep additional computation and I/O overhead low. Building on DSpark's parallel backbone and sequential prediction head, ReaDy employs a lightweight two-stage adaptation strategy, with reader capacity, state sources, and residual placement examined through ablation studies. Across seven benchmarks spanning mathematics, code generation, and dialogue, ReaDy achieves an average $3.16\times$ decoding speedup over autoregressive decoding with Qwen3.8-27B on a single NVIDIA B200 GPU. It outperforms DSpark on every benchmark, improving throughput by 7.97% and acceptance length by 8.50% on average. Our code is available at https://github.com/StartLuxLabs/ReaDy.
blocks.zh: 光谱解码通过每步起草多个令牌来加速自动递归生成,然而基于特征的起草者依赖于目标隐藏特征,其上下文重点可能与后续的草案位置的需要不相符合. 混合线性关注(HLA)模式保持了累积历史关联的紧凑的反复状态,为投机性起草提供了有效的互补背景来源. 我们提出ReaDy,这是第一种推测性的解码方法,就我们所知,利用HLA的反复状态,在起草过程中进行特定位置上下文检索. ReaDy为每个草稿位置配备一个学到的查询,直接从目标承诺的反复状态获取补充上下文. 轻量级状态读取器通过剩余更新将这种上下文纳入草稿表达方式,而低级别状态读取和引信操作员则保持额外的计算,I/O的间接费用低. 在DSpark平行骨干和顺序预测头的基础上,ReaDy采用了轻量级的两阶段适应战略,读者能力,状态来源,剩余位置通过衰减研究进行检查. 在跨越数学,代码生成,和对话框的7个基准中,ReaDy在单NVIDIA B200 GPU上实现了平均3.16\times$的自转解码速度,而不是与Qune3.8-27B的自转解码. 它在每个基准上都超过了DSpark,平均吞吐量提高了7.97%,接受长度提高了8.50%. 我们的代码可以在https://github.com/StartLuxLabs/ReaDy上找到.

blocks.en: Hybrid linear attention (HLA) offers a practical route to efficient long-context language modeling. By combining recurrent layers with full or sparse attention, HLA reduces the cost of maintaining context while retaining fine-grained retrieval capabilities ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Qwen Team, 2025 ) . Autoregressive generation nevertheless remains sequential. Speculative decoding addresses this bottleneck: a lightweight drafter proposes several tokens for the target to verify together, reducing the number of target invocations needed to generate a sequence ( Leviathan et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 混合线性注意(HLA)为高效的长文本语言建模提供了一个实用的路径. 通过将经常层与完全或稀少的注意力结合起来,HLA降低了维持上下文的成本,同时保留精细的检索能力(Yang等人,2025年;Quen Team,2025年)。 然而,自动生成仍按顺序进行。 光谱解码解决了这个瓶颈:一个轻量级的起草者提出几个令牌供目标一起验证,减少生成序列所需的目标引用次数(Leviathan等人,2023年).

blocks.en: Recent advances reduce the sequential cost of drafting itself. DFlash predicts token blocks in parallel from target hidden features ( Chen et al., 2026 ) ; DSpark combines a parallel backbone with a lightweight sequential head to capture dependencies within each block ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) . Training that exposes drafters to their own predictions or accounts for verification further improves draft–target agreement ( Li et al., 2025 ; Gu et al., 2026 ) . For semi-autoregressive drafting, however, the backbone must prepare representations for several future positions at once. Its predictions therefore depend on whether the supplied context supports the needs of the entire block.
blocks.zh: 最近的进展降低了起草本身的顺序成本。 DFlash从目标隐藏特征(Chen et al., 2026)中平行预测符号块;DSpark将平行主干与轻量级顺序头结合,以捕捉每个块内的依赖性(Cheng et al., 2026). 使起草者了解自己预测或核查情况的培训进一步改进了目标协议草案(Li等人,2025年;Gu等人,2026年)。 但是,对于半自动的起草,骨干部门必须同时为未来的若干职位准备陈述。 因此,其预测取决于所提供的上下文是否支持整个区块的需要。

blocks.en: Target hidden features provide a selective view of the prefix. Learned under next-token prediction, they reflect context selected by the target’s queries at observed positions ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . Later draft positions can require relationships that those readouts do not emphasize. The drafter can attend over the supplied features, but this does not give it direct access to the underlying target memory. KVShot enables fresh retrieval through the target’s KV cache ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . That access, however, reads token-wise memory whose size grows with the prefix, increasing the I/O cost of supplying additional context.
blocks.zh: 目标隐藏特性提供了前缀的选择性视图. 根据下一个预测,它们反映了目标在观测到的位置(Liu等人,2026年)的询问所选择的背景。 后来起草的立场可能要求这些宣读者不强调的关系。 起草者可以参加所提供的功能,但这并不能使其直接访问基础目标内存. KVShot 可以通过目标 KV 缓存(Liu et al., 2026) 进行新检索 。 然而,这种访问读取了象征性的内存,其大小随前缀而增加,增加了提供额外上下文的I/O成本。

blocks.en: HLA offers a different source: recurrent states that compactly accumulate historical associations in fixed-size matrices. Direct access to these states lets each draft position seek supplementary context with its learned query, without scanning a growing token-wise cache. The challenge is to make this information useful for block prediction while keeping computation and I/O cost low.
blocks.zh: HLA提供了一个不同的来源:反复出现的说法是,在固定大小的矩阵中紧凑地积累历史关联. 直接访问这些状态可以让每个草稿位置用其学到的查询来寻求补充上下文,而不会扫描一个日益增长的按符号的缓存. 挑战在于使这种信息对区块预测有用,同时保持计算和I/O成本低.

blocks.en: We introduce ReaDy , a state-conditioned speculative decoding method for HLA models. ReaDy augments DSpark’s parallel backbone with a reader that forms a query from each draft representation, reads selected target states, and injects the retrieved context through a residual update. It retains DSpark’s sequential prediction head and target verification, allowing only committed states to inform subsequent drafting rounds. We summarize our contributions as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们引入了ReaDy, HLA模型的一种有条件的投机解码方法. ReaDy 增加了 DSpark 的平行主干线, 并配备一个阅读器, 由每个代理草稿组成一个查询, 读取选定的目标状态, 并通过剩余更新输入检索到的上下文 。 它保留了DSpark的顺序预测头和目标核查,只允许承诺国为随后的起草回合提供参考. 我们的贡献总结如下:

blocks.en: • To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to propose leveraging HLA recurrent states as a complementary source of context for speculative drafting. Our theoretical analysis characterizes when new state queries can reveal information not determined by existing readouts, motivating position-specific retrieval from committed states. • We develop ReaDy, a recurrent-state-conditioned speculative decoding method that equips each draft position with a learned state query and integrates the retrieved context through lightweight residual updates. Low-rank state reads, fused operators, and a two-stage adaptation strategy enable efficient integration with a pretrained drafter. • Experiments across seven benchmarks with Qwen3.8-27B demonstrate that ReaDy improves decoding throughput and acceptance length over DSpark by 7.97% and 8.50% on average, respectively, achieving an average 3.16 × \times speedup over autoregressive decoding.

Full proofs and assumptions are given in Appendix A ; Appendix D reviews the underlying attention and speculative-decoding mechanisms.

blocks.en: These observations motivate ReaDy’s context-access design. A learned reader maps each draft representation to a query of the same committed state, allowing the retrieved context to vary across the block without advancing the target state. Residual integration retains the backbone’s role in modeling the continuation and combining that context with hidden features. The fixed-size state supplies this information without a token-wise memory scan. Section 3 places these reads within ReaDy’s semi-autoregressive drafting and verification process.
blocks.zh: 这些观测激发了ReaDy的上下文访问设计. 一个有学识的读者将每个表达式草稿映射到同一个承诺状态的查询中,使得检索到的上下文可以在不推进目标状态的情况下在整个块中变化. 剩余整合保留了骨干在模拟延续和将背景与隐藏特征相结合方面的作用。 固定大小的状态提供这种信息时,没有按符号进行内存扫描. 第3节将这些内容置于ReaDy的半自动起草和核查过程中。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: ReaDy is a DSpark-based, state-conditioned speculative decoding method for HLA models. It combines block prediction with position-conditioned reads from the target’s committed recurrent states (Figure 2 ). We use DSpark’s parallel backbone and sequential prediction head ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) , and introduce a state-reading path in the final draft layer. Section 4.1 describes initialization and training.
blocks.zh: ReaDy是HLA模型的一种基于DSpark,有条件的投机解码方法. 它将区块预测与位置条件从目标承诺的反复状态(图2)中读取。 我们使用DSpark的平行骨干和顺序预测头(Cheng et al., 2026),并在最后的草稿层引入了状态读取路径. 第4.1节介绍了初始化和培训。

These matrices summarize prefix associations without retaining a separate entry for every token. All draft positions access the same committed states; the information retrieved from them depends on the representation at each position.

blocks.en: Each round uses target hidden features and recurrent states associated with the committed history. The parallel backbone forms the draft representations, the reader supplies position-specific context, and the sequential head produces the candidate block. Under our greedy decoding setting, the target accepts the longest candidate prefix matching its argmax predictions. The first mismatch ends acceptance: the remaining proposals are discarded, and a target-supplied correction is committed with the accepted prefix. If the whole block is accepted, the target supplies a bonus token, unless generation has terminated. Subsequent rounds read only states associated with committed tokens; states from rejected continuations are not retained. This process repeats until EOS or the output limit. ReaDy changes how proposals are conditioned while retaining the existing verification rule.

blocks.en: A fixed-size context source can still incur substantial overhead if gathering and preparation materialize intermediate tensors. We optimize this path as illustrated in Figure 3 . A fused gather kernel writes selected committed states directly into a preallocated execution buffer, eliminating an intermediate tensor and an additional copy. We fuse pointwise state preparation and readout feature packing to avoid separate passes over intermediate results. Native RMSNorm kernels further avoid redundant casts. These changes reduce the execution cost of the reader without changing which committed states it accesses.

blocks.en: 4.1 Training and Evaluation Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 培训和评价设置

blocks.en: We use Qwen3.8-27B as the target and initialize ReaDy’s drafting backbone and prediction head from a pretrained DSpark model ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) released by RadixArk. 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-DSpark We adapt the drafter on Open-PerfectBlend. 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/datasets/mlabonne/open-perfectblend In the first stage, we freeze the drafter and train only the state reader on 20k samples. In the second stage, we jointly train the reader and the drafter’s LoRA parameters ( Hu et al., 2021 ) on 50k samples. The target model remains frozen throughout. Both stages use ℒ = ℒ CE + 0.1 ​ ℒ L1 , \mathcal{L}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{CE}}+0.1\,\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{L1}}, (5) combining cross-entropy with an L1 loss between draft and target probability distributions, without a confidence loss. This objective and adaptation recipe differ from DSpark’s original training. Comparisons with the pretrained DSpark baseline therefore reflect both adaptation and state access; Table 2 additionally compares ReaDy with fine-tuning without state access. Appendix B describes the data mixture, loss aggregation, and optimizer settings.

blocks.en: We compare ReaDy with autoregressive (AR) decoding and the pretrained DSpark drafter. Each model instance runs on one NVIDIA B200 GPU with SGLang ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) , using BF16 without quantization and a request concurrency of one. Evaluation requests are distributed across GPUs, with each input compared across methods on the same GPU. All methods use greedy decoding (temperature zero), with thinking enabled, a maximum of 1,024 output tokens, and a context limit of 16,384 tokens. Generation stops upon EOS. Both DSpark and ReaDy use a draft block size of seven. Unless otherwise specified, ReaDy reads target states from layers 30 and 62 with reader rank eight and injects the resulting residual once, after attention in the final draft layer.
blocks.zh: 我们比较ReaDy与自动递归(AR)解码和预训的DSpark起草器. 每个模型实例运行在一个带有SGLang(Zheng等人,2024年)的NVIDIA B200 GPU上,使用BF16而不进行量化,请求的货币为1. 评价请求分布在GPU之间,每个输入在同一GPU上对不同方法进行比较. 所有方法都使用贪婪的解码(温度0),并启用思维功能,最多可使用1,024个输出令牌,上下文限制为16,384个令牌. 世代停止在EOS。 DSpark和ReaDy都使用7块大小的草稿. 除非另有说明,ReaDy从第30层和第62层读取目标状态,读者排在第8位,并在最后的草稿层注意后,一次注入所产生的残留.

blocks.en: We evaluate seven benchmarks across three task categories. Mathematical reasoning is evaluated on GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) and MATH500 ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) . For code generation, we use sanitized MBPP ( Austin et al., 2021 ) , HumanEval ( Chen et al., 2021 ) , and LiveCodeBench ( Jain et al., 2024 ) . Dialogue and instruction following are evaluated using the first turn of MT-Bench ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) and a fixed Alpaca subset ( Taori et al., 2023 ) . We report server-side decoding throughput in tokens per second (TPS), excluding prefill. Acceptance length is the total number of output tokens divided by the total number of verification rounds, including tokens supplied by the target model; it therefore measures the average progress per verification. For the overall throughput comparison, we first average TPS across benchmarks and then compute speedups from these averages.
blocks.zh: 我们评价三个任务类别的七项基准。 数学推理在GSM8K(Cobbe等人,2021年)和MATH500(Hendrycks等人,2021年)上评价. 对于代码生成,我们使用消毒的MBPP(Austin等人,2021年),Human Eval(Chen等人,2021年),以及LiveCode Bench(Jain等人,2024年). 以下的对话和指示使用MT-Bench(Zheng等人,2023年)和固定的Alpaca子集(Taori等人,2023年)进行评审。 我们报告服务器侧的解码吞吐量每秒(TPS),不包括预填. 接受长度是产出标志的总数除以核查回合的总数,包括目标模型提供的标志;因此,它衡量每次核查的平均进度。 就总的吞吐量比较而言,我们首先跨越基准计算平均TPS,然后从这些平均数计算速度。

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that ReaDy improves both throughput and acceptance length on every benchmark. Its mean decoding throughput reaches 302.78 tokens/s, compared with 95.86 for AR decoding and 280.42 for DSpark, yielding a 3.16 × \times speedup over AR and a further 7.97% gain over DSpark. The improvement extends across task types: throughput gains over DSpark range from 6.43% to 8.66% on mathematics and code generation, and reach 9.45% on MT-Bench and 9.83% on Alpaca. The corresponding overall acceptance-length gain is 8.50%. Thus, the additional progress per verification is sufficient to offset the cost of state retrieval in the evaluated setting. The slightly smaller throughput gain also highlights the need to control reader overhead, which motivates the design comparisons below. Appendix C illustrates how an early mismatch affects block acceptance in an individual generation.
blocks.zh: 表1显示,ReaDy在每一基准上都改善了吞吐量和验收长度。 其平均解码吞吐量达到302.78个令牌/秒,而AR解码为95.86个令牌,DSpark为280.42个令牌,使AR比3.16×\时速增速,DSpark再比7.97%增速. 改进涉及各种任务类型:在数学和代码生成方面,DSpark的吞吐量增益在6.43%至8.66%之间,在MT-Bench和Alpaca方面则分别达到9.4%和9.83%。 相应的总接受长度增益为8.50%. 因此,每次核查的额外进展足以抵消评价环境下的国家检索费用。 略小的吞吐量增益也突出了控制读者间接费用的必要性,这就促使下文的设计比较. 附 录 C说明早期不匹配如何影响单个代群的接受.

blocks.en: 4.3 Draft-Prefix Survival
blocks.zh: 4.3 生存草稿

blocks.en: Mean acceptance length summarizes overall progress but does not show how agreement changes across a draft block. We therefore examine all seven proposed positions using the final checkpoint. Figure 5 reports cumulative prefix survival for Math (GSM8K), Code (HumanEval), and Chat (MT-Bench). At position j j , this is the fraction of eligible drafting rounds in which all of the first j j proposed tokens are accepted, rather than the acceptance probability conditional on earlier positions surviving. ReaDy has higher prefix survival at every position in all three benchmarks. At the seventh position, survival increases from 45.98% to 58.17% on GSM8K, from 25.89% to 31.19% on HumanEval, and from 12.59% to 16.11% on MT-Bench. Thus, a larger fraction of ReaDy’s complete seven-token proposals survive verification. Appendix E describes the measurement protocol and its scope.

blocks.en: To assess the benefit beyond additional training, Table 2 includes a fine-tuned DSpark variant without the state adapter. Fine-tuning alone raises throughput from 280.42 to 286.50 tokens/s and acceptance length from 4.1739 to 4.2732, confirming that adaptation contributes to the improvement over the original checkpoint. ReaDy further reaches 302.78 tokens/s and an acceptance length of 4.5285: gains of 5.68% and 5.97%, respectively, over this no-state variant. This comparison supports an additional benefit from state-conditioned adaptation. The 7.97% throughput gain over pretrained DSpark therefore reflects both continued adaptation and state access.

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: Drafters can reuse target hidden features or query target memory directly. GliDe ( Du et al., 2024 ) and LongSpec ( Yang et al., 2026 ) access the target’s KV cache through cross-attention. KVShot ( Liu et al., 2026 ) compares hidden-feature and KV-cache reuse, highlighting the trade-off between richer context and retrieval cost. Although cache sharing avoids duplicate storage, reading token-wise history incurs memory traffic that grows with the number of attended tokens. ReaDy instead queries fixed-size recurrent states, using low-rank reads and fused operators to limit the additional I/O cost.
blocks.zh: 起草者可以直接重用目标隐藏特性或查询目标内存. GliDe(Du等人,2024年)和LongSpec(Yang等人,2026年)通过交叉注意访问目标KV缓存. KVShot(Liu等人,2026年)比较了隐藏地貌和KV-cache再利用,突出了较丰富的上下文与检索成本之间的权衡. 虽然缓存共享可以避免重复存储,但读取令牌历史会产生随被关注令牌数量增长的内存流量. ReaDy转而询问固定大小的经常性状态,使用低级读取和引信操作器来限制额外的I/O成本.

blocks.en: Recurrent targets require dependency-aware verification and recovery of accepted states. Wang et al. (2024) address these challenges for Mamba and hybrid models; STree ( Wu et al., 2025 ) extends tree verification to hybrid state-space models. SpecLA ( Wang et al., 2026 ) combines topology-aware verification and factor-based state recovery with EAGLE-style drafting from recurrent target features. ReaDy focuses on position-conditioned reads of committed states for block drafting. We analyze this context interface and study reader capacity, state sources, and residual placement within a DSpark-based implementation.
blocks.zh: 经常性目标需要了解依赖情况,并对接受国家进行恢复。 Wang等人(2024年)针对曼巴和混合模型的这些挑战;STree(Wu等人,2025年)将树的验证扩展到混合状态-空间模型. SpecLA (Wang et al., 2026) 结合了地形意识验证和基于要素的状态恢复与EAGLE风格从经常性目标特征起草. ReaDy主要关注承诺状态的有条件位置读数,以进行区块起草。 我们分析这种上下文界面,研究阅读能力、国家来源以及基于DSpark的实施工作中的剩余位置。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented ReaDy, a DSpark-based, state-conditioned speculative decoding method for HLA models. Its reader retrieves position-specific context from committed recurrent states and integrates it with draft representations through residual updates. Low-rank reads and fused operators control the additional I/O overhead. ReaDy achieves an average 3.16 × \times speedup over autoregressive decoding and a 7.97% throughput improvement over DSpark across seven benchmarks on Qwen3.8-27B using a single NVIDIA B200 GPU. These results demonstrate the value of recurrent-state retrieval for improving draft agreement and decoding efficiency within DSpark’s semi-autoregressive architecture.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了ReaDy,一种基于DSpark的,有条件的HLA模型的投机解码方法. 其读者从承诺的经常性状态中检索具体立场的背景,并通过剩余更新将其与陈述草稿合并。 低级读取和引信操作员控制额外的I/O管理费用. ReaDy在Qwen3.8-27B上通过一个单一的NVIDIA B200GPU,实现了平均3.16×\时速比自转解码速度加快,超过DSpark的吞吐量提升7.97%. 这些结果表明,经常状态检索对于改善DSpark半自动结构内协定草案和编码效率很有价值。

blocks.en: Future work will explore training the complete drafter from scratch and learning to allocate state access and readout capacity across draft positions.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作将探索从零开始对完整的起草者进行培训,并学习如何将国家接入和宣读能力分配给各草案职位。

blocks.en: Hybrid linear attention interleaves recurrent layers with full-attention layers, combining compact state-based context modeling with access to individual cached tokens ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) . The recurrent layers maintain fixed-size states, while full-attention layers retain growing KV caches. This layer organization also shapes activation dynamics: massive activations form spikes before full-attention layers and can persist as plateaus across intervening linear-attention layers ( Su et al., 2026 ) . ReaDy accesses the recurrent states as supplementary context for drafting, without changing the target’s hybrid architecture.
blocks.zh: 混合线性注意力互留层与全注层互留层,结合紧凑的状态上下文模型与访问单个缓存的代号(Quen Team,2025) . 经常层保持固定大小状态,而全注意层则保留了不断增长的KV缓存. 这种层层组织还塑造了激活动力学:大规模激活在全注层之前形成突起,并可作为跨干涉线注层的高原持续存在(Su等人,2026年)。 ReaDy在不改变目标混合结构的情况下,将经常状态作为起草的补充背景。

blocks.en: D.3 Target and Drafter Architectures
blocks.zh: D.3 目标和起草结构

blocks.en: Qwen3.8-27B has a dense language backbone with 64 layers and hidden width 5,120. 3 3 3 https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B Its layer pattern repeats three Gated DeltaNet layers followed by one gated full-attention layer, yielding 48 recurrent layers and 16 full-attention layers. The former retain fixed-size matrix states, while the latter use token-wise KV caches. The published configuration specifies 128-dimensional recurrent keys and values, giving the 128 × 128 128\times 128 per-head states accessed by ReaDy. Under zero-based indexing, the selected source layers 30 and 62 are both recurrent layers. ReaDy leaves this hybrid target architecture unchanged and adds a read-only interface to its committed recurrent states.
blocks.zh: 文选3.8-27 B语言骨干密集,有64层,藏宽5,120. 3 3 https://huggingface.co/Quen/Qune3.8-27B 它的地层图案重复了三层Gated DeltaNet,然后是一门式全注层,产生48个经常层和16个全注层. 前者保留了固定大小矩阵状态,而后者则使用符号式的 KV 缓存. 已发布的配置指定了128维的重复键和值,使128×128128\times128的每头状态被ReaDy访问. 在零基索引下,选定的源层30和62都是经常层. ReaDy保留了这个混合目标架构不变,并在其承诺的反复状态中增加了只读界面.

blocks.en: DSpark ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) combines a DFlash-based parallel backbone ( Chen et al., 2026 ) with a lightweight sequential prediction head. The backbone processes a block in one forward pass to produce position-wise representations and base logits. A sequential head adds transition biases conditioned on earlier proposals: the paper’s Markov variant uses the preceding token through a low-rank transition map, while its RNN variant carries a within-block hidden state. DSpark also introduces confidence-based verification scheduling, separately from this drafting architecture. ReaDy supplies additional target-state context to the backbone through residual updates.
blocks.zh: DSpark(Cheng等人,2026年)将一个基于DFlash的平行骨干(Chen等人,2026年)与一个轻量级的顺序预测头结合. 骨干处理一个前传的块,以产生位置表示和基数。 按顺序排列的头会增加以先前提案为条件的过渡偏差:纸张的Markov变体通过低级的过渡图使用前一种符号,而RNN变体则带有块内隐藏状态. DSpark还引入了基于信任的核查时间安排,与这个起草架构分开. ReaDy通过剩余更新为骨干提供了额外的目标状态上下文.

blocks.en: The RadixArk Qwen3.8-27B-DSpark model card describes five full-attention draft layers with hidden width 5,120, 32 query heads, and eight KV heads. It receives auxiliary target features from layers 5, 19, 33, 47, and 61 and uses a rank-256 Markov head. These are properties of the released drafter that initializes ReaDy; the rank-eight setting in Section 3.1 belongs to our state reader. The original hidden-feature path and the added recurrent-state path therefore expose different interfaces to target context.
blocks.zh: RadixArk Quen3.8-27B-DSpark型号卡片描述了5个全注式草稿层,隐藏宽度5,120,32个查询头,以及8个KV头. 它从5,19,33,47和61层接收辅助目标特征,并使用256马可夫头. 这些是被释放的起草者初始化ReaDy的属性;第3.1节中的八级设置属于我们的州级读者. 因此,原始的隐藏地貌路径和新增的经常性状态路径将不同的界面暴露于目标上下文.
